author: Codex session 25
body: Randy authorized a prospective time-only revision at 18:52 PDT on October 3. Chose and hash-froze 3600 model, 4200 encounter simulation and 4500 encounter wall seconds from the two retained failures, before any new invocation. The 17/20 and 15/20 used actions, exact 9.153/8.949 MB native core charges over about 610 simulation seconds, and 27.29/27.52 MB public histories support a separate non-time budget question: 120 actions, 256 MiB native core and 2 GiB host evidence are proposed only. Linear capacity projections exceed old core/host ceilings; they do not prove that a fresh task needs more than 20 actions or predict success. All old outcomes, source/evidence identities and safety/validity criteria stay unchanged. No revised executable or live attempt is registered while the explicitly required human decision is pending. Measured original inputs are unchanged and historical preservation passed all 16409 files. See linked proposal, measured inputs and freeze for exact limits and remaining long-duration qualification.

evidence.label: Source-bound read-only measurements and conditional projections
